blurb: Candidate: AI Product Engineer and solo founder in Saudi Arabia who builds and deploys LLM-powered products and production automations end to end. Founder of Watheq, an Arabic-first bilingual AI resume optimization and job-matching platform deployed in production for the Saudi market, built solo with React 19, TypeScript, Netlify Functions, Supabase/PostgreSQL with row-level security, Upstash Redis rate limiting, OpenRouter/Gemini, and server-side PDF generation. He implemented credit-based monetization, guest rate limiting, Moyasar payment integration with 3DS flows, and Arabic/Hijri date handling. He builds evidence-constrained LLM workflows for parsing, matching, gap analysis, interview questions, and resume improvement, with Zod validation, anti-hallucination output rules, gold-set evaluation harnesses, deterministic scoring, and quality-drift checks. He built bilingual PDF/DOCX processing with Arabic/English detection, OCR fallback, structured JSON recovery, real-time progress, and ATS-safe PDF exports. He also runs production automation on GitHub Actions: a Saudi job-discovery and ranking pipeline across five ATS APIs with fail-soft discovery, employer verification, apply-link recovery, quota controls, evidence-aware ranking, and Discord delivery. His TASI market-analysis platform combines Python, TypeScript, React/Next.js, deterministic technical rules, scheduled workflows, Discord alerts, a 5-year walk-forward backtest, provider failover, and CI contract tests. Python, TypeScript, and SQL, with commercial operations and data analytics since March 2020 and hands-on AI product engineering since August 2025. Do not count the commercial/analytics years as years of software engineering. RAG concepts and n8n are listed knowledge/skills, not evidence of shipped RAG or n8n workflows. Native Arabic and professional English. Wants junior, associate and mid-level individual-contributor AI/LLM and software roles, and mid-level and senior hands-on data-analytics roles based in Saudi Arabia only; roles based outside Saudi Arabia are not a match even with relocation. He also targets sales operations, commercial and retail analytics, customer insights/CRM analytics, and senior sales/advisory individual-contributor roles, judged against his Alghalia experience. He prefers hands-on individual-contributor work and not people management. EDUCATION: diploma in Pipefitting Technology from Saudi Petroleum Services Polytechnic (2018), GPA 4.6/5, and NO bachelor's degree. Everything in software and AI is self-taught and shipped rather than credentialed. A posting that states a bachelor's degree as a minimum qualification is a real gap; a degree that is preferred or accepts equivalent experience is not. WHAT HE DOES NOT DO: he BUILDS WITH models, he does not build models. Do not credit model training, fine-tuning, TensorFlow, PyTorch, scikit-learn, deep learning, MLOps, feature engineering, or formal statistics/data-science study. His evaluation work judge-scores LLM prompts and model variants, not models he trained. A posting requiring model development, fine-tuning, or a classical ML stack is a wrong-function match and belongs in the 0-39 band. Current search policy: JOB_SEARCH_PREFERENCES.md. Full-time Saudi Arabia only; Riyadh is the CV presentation location, not an exclusion of other Saudi cities. Prioritize AI product/engineering, software/product engineering and data analysis; other tracks require material demonstrated alignment. Never describe the candidate as a fresh graduate or infer Jira or Slack experience.

tracks.name: AI and LLM product engineering
tracks.evidence: Judge against the Watheq experience entry and the selected AI and automation projects in the resume. This is LLM application engineering only: the resume shows no model training, fine-tuning, TensorFlow, PyTorch, or scikit-learn. RAG concepts and n8n are listed without demonstrated project evidence; do not treat either as shipped implementation experience.

tracks.name: Software engineering, front and back
tracks.evidence: Judge against the Watheq experience entry and the selected AI and automation projects in the resume. Frontend is evidenced by React 19, TypeScript, real-time product delivery, and bilingual document UX; payment and monetization work is Moyasar integration, credits, and guest rate limiting; backend is Supabase/PostgreSQL, Netlify Functions, Python automation, and APIs. Hands-on AI product engineering begins in Aug 2025, so a posting requiring several years of dedicated software engineering is a real gap.

tracks.name: Data and analytics
tracks.evidence: Judge against the Alghalia experience entry, which runs from Mar 2020. It evidences commercial analytics, Power BI reporting, customer segmentation, and competitor/pricing analysis, not production data engineering, warehouse ETL, Spark, Kafka, or Airflow. Match mid-level and senior hands-on analytics roles to this commercial analytics experience.

tracks.name: Commercial and sales operations
tracks.evidence: Judge against the Alghalia experience since March 2020: weekly sales performance reporting, Power BI dashboards, segmentation of 100+ customer accounts, cross-sell analysis, competitor/pricing intelligence, and reduced expired-unit waste. These are hands-on commercial analytics roles, not general accounting, finance, or people management. Do not infer Salesforce, CRM administration, formal business-analysis methods, or tools not demonstrated in the resume.

tracks.name: Sales and customer advisory

Do not infer enterprise presales, quota attainment, closing metrics, sales leadership, or industry experience absent from the resume. Adjacent only: do not broaden into unrelated sales merely to fill the digest.

tracks.evidence: Judge against the Watheq EXPERIENCE/PROJECTS entries and the Alghalia analysis and sales work. Include only when the actual responsibilities materially align with demonstrated Watheq software/AI product delivery, Alghalia analysis or sales work. Product or program titles do not establish people-management experience. No Jira or Slack experience may be inferred.
